name: com.messagepack-csharp.unity
description: UnityEngine type formatters (Vector2/3/4, Quaternion, Color, Rect, Bounds, Matrix4x4, AnimationCurve, Gradient, ...) for MessagePack for C# v4, in the v3-compatible array wire form. The serializer core (MessagePack, SerializerFoundation and their dependencies, including the source generator) comes from NuGet, e.g. through NuGetForUnity.
